headline: Status Yellow - Rain warning for Clare, Cork, Donegal, Galway, Kerry, Leitrim, Limerick, Mayo, Sligo
description:
Storm Boelo will bring spells of heavy rain. 

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Outdoor events impacted

headline: Status Yellow - Wind warning for Donegal
description:
Storm Boelo: Very strong southwest winds will veer westerly with severe gusts and coastal gales.

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Debris, loose objects displaced
  • Difficult driving and cycling conditions
  • Large coastal waves
  • Some fallen trees, branches
  • Outdoor events impacted

headline: Status Orange - Rain warning for Kerry
description:
Storm Boelo will bring spells of very heavy and intense rain. 

Prepare for impacts:

  • Damage to homes and businesses expected
  • Disruption and delays to public transport (rail, bus)
  • Flooding expected
  • Outdoor events severely disrupted
  • Very difficult travelling conditions
